content: Floci 1.5.x claims EC2 VPC resources and RDS Docker-backed MySQL. MageLift CI pins floci/floci:1.5.33; current Magelift Floci tests cover ECS/state/secrets not VPC/RDS import. Offline attach proof should prefer Pulumi mocks (existing network pattern) plus optional Floci Describe/Create smoke if endpoint stable; do not claim AWS fidelity from Floci.
